audit_3_evaluator_matching_rule.code_excerpt_lines_256_285:
# A nodule is marked as detected when the center of mass of the candidate is within a distance R of
            # the center of the nodule. In order to ensure that the CAD mark is displayed within the nodule on the
            # CT scan, we set R to be the radius of the nodule size.
            diameter = float(noduleAnnot.diameter_mm)
            if diameter < 0.0:
              diameter = 10.0
            radiusSquared = pow((diameter / 2.0), 2.0)

            found = False
            noduleMatches = []
            for key, candidate in candidates.iteritems():
                x2 = float(candidate.coordX)
                y2 = float(candidate.coordY)
                z2 = float(candidate.coordZ)
                dist = math.pow(x - x2, 2.) + math.pow(y - y2, 2.) + math.pow(z - z2, 2.)
                if dist < radiusSquared:
                    if (noduleAnnot.state == "Included"):
                        found = True
                        noduleMatches.append(candidate)
                        if key not in candidates2.keys():
                            print "This is strange: CAD mark %s detected two nodules! Check for overlapping nodule annotations, SeriesUID: %s, nodule Annot ID: %s" % (str(candidate.id), seriesuid, str(noduleAnnot.id))
                        else:
                            del candidates2[key]
                    elif (noduleAnnot.state == "Excluded"): # an excluded nodule
                        if bOtherNodulesAsIrrelevant: #    delete marks on excluded nodules so they don't count as false positives
                            if key in candidates2.keys():
                                irrelevantCandidates += 1
                                ignoredCADMarksList.append("%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%.9f" % (seriesuid, -1, candidate.coordX, candidate.coordY, candidate.coordZ, str(candidate.id), float(candidate.CADprobability)))
                                del candidates2[key]
            if len(noduleMatches) > 1: # double detection
audit_3_evaluator_matching_rule.included_nodule_radius: R = diameter / 2.0 (Strictly half of nodule diameter; no minimum radius floor).
audit_3_evaluator_matching_rule.excluded_finding_fallback: If diameter < 0.0, fallback diameter = 10.0 mm -> R = 5.0 mm. If diameter >= 0.0, R = diameter / 2.0.
audit_3_evaluator_matching_rule.reconciliation_note: The description max(d/2, 5 mm) is mathematically and factually incorrect. It conflates the excluded-finding negative diameter fallback (10 mm / 2 = 5 mm) with the included nodule matching rule (strictly d/2).

audit_4_no_mining_and_bootstrap.correction_of_pool_description: The no-mining control B did NOT train on 28,536 examples. It trained on 16,728 examples (984 positives + 15,744 random negatives) with 22 random negatives per batch, skipping hard-negative mining entirely while matching update count at 2,750 steps.

bootstrap_interpretation_correction.interpretation: The proportion of bootstrap replicates where delta > 0 is an empirical sample statistic (bootstrap quantile), NOT a Bayesian posterior probability of true superiority. Because the 95% percentile bootstrap CI [-0.0147, +0.0511] spans zero, the two-sided null hypothesis H0: delta = 0 cannot be rejected (p approx 0.23 > 0.05). There is no statistically significant difference established.

protocol_distinction.candidate_classification_track1: Evaluates false-positive reduction on candidate lists generated by a specified candidate generator. Must evaluate against all candidate coordinates (true nodules and natural background candidates).
protocol_distinction.end_to_end_detection_track2: Evaluates complete CAD pipeline from raw CT volumes to final detections, scoring FROC and CPM. Candidate proposal misses directly penalize upper-bound sensitivity.
protocol_distinction.ground_truth_centered_limitation: Evaluating solely on ground-truth-centered positive patches measures local classifier sensitivity on known nodules, but provides zero measurement of false-positive rate per scan and does NOT establish detection readiness or external CAD performance.
